description: Lists real cross-border payment outcomes per corridor and size band: date, corridor, size band, route type (bank, payout_network, otc, exchange, stablecoin, card), the all-in cost in bps against the official or mid-market reference of that day, what the figure is (a payment that landed, receipt figures, a quoted rate, a published rate, a P2P advert median) and a source label on every row: MEASURED (SwapEazi's own reads and receipts), PUBLIC REPORT (a published rate, with its link), SELF-REPORTED (submitted by a business) or VERIFIED (submitted with a receipt SwapEazi matched). Also medians per corridor, size band and source; sources are never pooled. Providers are masked unless the submitter chose to name them. A record, not advice, not a quote and not a ranking. Free; same as GET /api/v1/index/payments.

corridor.description: Two currency codes, e.g. 'ZAR-MZN'. Or use from and to.

currency.description: Rows where this currency is sent or received.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (next_offset from the last answer).

route.description: Route type: bank, payout_network, otc, exchange, stablecoin, card or not_stated.

size.description: Size band: under_20k_usd, 20k_100k_usd, 100k_1m_usd, 1m_10m_usd, 10m_plus_usd, unknown_size or all_sizes (a rate, any size).

name: payment_index
title: Read the SwapEazi Payment Index
